questions.prompt: What is the most effective way to prevent images from causing layout shift?

options.text: Give each image its width and height attributes (or a CSS aspect-ratio) so space is reserved before it loads

questions.explanation: With width/height (or aspect-ratio) the browser knows the aspect ratio and reserves the right space before the image loads, so content below never jumps. Keep height:auto in CSS for responsiveness.

questions.prompt: Which layout shifts do NOT count toward CLS?

options.text: Shifts that happen within 500 ms of a user interaction
Shifts in the first second of load

questions.explanation: Shifts within 500 ms of a user interaction are flagged hadRecentInput and treated as expected (e.g. opening an accordion you clicked), so they're excluded from CLS.

questions.prompt: Which of these are common causes of layout shift? Select all that apply.

options.text: Ad or embed slots that grow from zero height
Content injected above existing content on load

questions.explanation: Unsized media, growing slots, and content inserted above existing content all shift the layout. transform/opacity animations do not move other content, so they don't cause shifts.

questions.prompt: The CSS property that reserves space for a box in a given width:height ratio (e.g. 16 / 9) is ____.
questions.explanation: CSS aspect-ratio reserves correctly proportioned space for elements without an intrinsic size, such as video embeds, preventing a shift when they load.

questions.prompt: Match each cause of layout shift to its fix.

pairs.left: Banner injected at top on load
pairs.right: Use a fixed overlay or reserve its space
Match fallback metrics or use font-display: optional

questions.explanation: Every CLS fix comes down to reserving space (dimensions, min-height) or not displacing existing content (overlays, matched font metrics).

questions.prompt: Order the steps to diagnose and fix a layout shift.

items.text: Record the page load in DevTools
Determine the cause (unsized media, injected content, font)
Reserve space or apply the matching fix

questions.explanation: Record, locate the shifting element, find its cause, apply the reserve-space fix, and confirm CLS improved.
